rice.description: Rice based dishes - plain rice, jeera rice, pulao/pulav, biryani, khichdi, dalia.

bread.description: Flatbreads and breads - roti, chapati, butter roti, naan, paratha, bhature, puri.

dal.description: Lentils and pulse gravies - dal fry/tadka/makhani, chana dal, arhar dal, chole, rajma.

curry.description: Thick vegetable / paneer / chicken gravies served in a katori.

raita_curd.description: Curd, dahi, raita and boondi raita (mess serves 100 ml curd, 150 ml raita).

egg.description: Whole boiled egg and egg bhurji.

snack.description: Fried or steamed breakfast items - dosa, idly, poha, pakoda, sandwich.

dessert.description: Sweet items - jalebi rabri, shahi tukda, gulab jamun, ice cream.

drink.description: Drinks - lassi, chaas, butter milk, lemon water, juices. Mess serves 200 ml.

salad.description: Raw salad, cucumber, carrot, tomato, beetroot, onion, chilli, lemon.

boilerplate.description: Items the mess serves every day regardless of the day of week.

serving_rules: 1. Breakfast: Subscribers can choose between a Boiled Egg (1 pc) or egg bhurji or Paneer bhurji. Also served daily are Milk (200
ml), Tea/Coffee (200 ml), bread with Jam and Butter, and extras like sprouts and boiled pulses along with ginger, tomato, chilli
2. Lunch/Dinner: Chapati (with and without ghee) and Plain Rice will be served daily. Non-spicy Jain food, Salad
(Cucumber+Carrot+Tomato+Beetroot), Chilli, Onion, and Lemon and fresh green chutney will be available daily.
3. Quantity for Drinks in Lunch/Dinner will be 200 ml. Quantity for curd and raita will be 100 and 150 ml respectively.
4. Curd to be always served with Parathas in breakfast.
Holiday Timings: Breakfast (8AM - 10:15 AM), Lunch (12.15 - 2.30 PM), Dinner (8PM - 10:00 PM)
